Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. When your Digimon attacks, the [Your Turn] effects on the 2 copies of this card trigger simultaneously. Effects that trigger simultaneously can be activated 1 at a time, therefore you can activate the [Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card, and once all effects have been resolved, you can then activate the [Your Turn] effect on the 2nd copy of this card.
